mainEntity.name: What is the typical class size for team training at Cave Training?

acceptedAnswer.text: Team training classes at Cave Training typically have a manageable number of participants to ensure each individual receives adequate coaching attention while maintaining a dynamic group atmosphere. The exact class size can vary depending on the time of day and specific program, but we aim to keep ratios that allow for effective instruction and safety. We strive to strike a balance between a supportive community feel and personalized guidance for functional fitness movements.
